question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & -4 & 5 \\ -1 & 2 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix given above. Identify **all** of the reasons why one can conclude that $|A|=0?$

I. $A$ has proportional columns

II. $A$ has identical columns

III. $A$ has identical rows

choices.value: None of the statements are true

current_example.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14159936/assets/1577a01b21889bd18c886ce5a11d17fa03989f032bfe3edabde57407fb1f4b64.svg)

Consider the matrix given above. Identify **all** of the reasons why one can conclude that $|A|=0.$

I. $A$ has a zero column

II. $A$ has proportional rows

III. $A$ has identical columns
current_example.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the statements in turn.

- $A$ has a zero column: 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14159936/assets/a5ccddc0640f27c28b4469fa3e9dc6debf4e5216c67f6bc49f894e26eac6c748.svg)

- $A$ has proportional rows: 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14159936/assets/138737153bd4bd877ed9a5e8cb0d60be7bcb66587bdcb1e750e62c3277de1dbc.svg)

- $A$ does *not* have identical columns.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and II only."
